name: Welzheim (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, green and white, charged above the centre with the city arms of Welzheim (a green fir on a mount on white).
history: Municipal flag of Welzheim; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Welzheim arms — green fir on white
